dedup_audit.kind: V12 independent native request-receipt dedup audit

scope.unit: Each immutable publisher version, separately within native decompose and verify.
scope.experiment_scope: The registered V12 arms each contain one native claim. Counts aggregate within an arm; this is not a policy for future multi-claim batches.
scope.counting: Every matched private request receipt counts, including failed dispatch attempts; blocked-dispatch rows do not. A receipt proves submitted-input preparation and a transport attempt, not that the remote model consumed it. Missing receipts fail closed.
scope.identity: URL, content, issuer, publication and availability metadata; local version ID and retrieval time are excluded from alias identity. Changed content/metadata stays distinct.
scope.retained_evidence: Previously accepted analyses and exact evidence may recur. They are not counted as newly supplied full-material fields, even for short source texts.
scope.excluded_stages: Full news research, source selection and shared final forecast remain separate.
